Home.title: What is in that plot?
Home.subtitle: Draw or upload plot boundaries and get an evidence-based forest risk assessment across multiple public datasets — powered by Google Earth Engine.
Home.intro: WHISP ("What is in that plot?") helps you verify supply chain commodities come from land free of recent deforestation — a core EUDR requirement. Draw or upload plot boundaries and get a risk assessment across <layers>data layers & indicators</layers>, powered by our <library>open-source library</library> via Google Earth Engine.

AnalysisOptions.title: Analysis options
AnalysisOptions.auditTrailHelp: Geospatial data may be modified slightly during the analysis in Google Earth Engine, especially notable for very small polygons. We return the modified output for transparency in what was analysed, but if you require your input data to be returned you can select this option and it will add an extra column called 'geo_original'.

ApiKey.regenBody: Your current key will be invalidated immediately. Any integrations using it will stop working. The new key is shown once — copy it before closing.
ApiKey.revokeBody: This permanently invalidates your key. All API calls using it will fail immediately. You can generate a new key afterwards.
